Android app live on Google Play

website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Self-serve product signup and e-commerce checkout; no sales-call booking
website_review.trust_signals: Transparent pricing page, SOC 2 compliance statement, app-store presence, named office address, integration and quick-start docs

Team/enterprise interest must come through a generic contact form with questions like 'what is one thing we can do to make your project a success' - manual triage per lead

top_opportunities.evidence: Pricing page lists $4.99, $9.59/member and card prices as text but the site exposes only a LocalBusiness JSON-LD node

Ability to pay: small SaaS at $5-10/month per seat with physical-card margins; limited budget and they may prefer to build in-house. Ease: small, well-scoped additions on a Drupal site. Evidence: opened home, contact and pricing references and inspected forms, schema and robots.

caveats: Google Business Profile ratings and review counts are reported from third-party aggregators and directories, not read from Google Maps directly; treat them as approximate.

Two sites (cwstrategiesllc.com, boraierealty.com) could not be rendered at all - one behind Cloudflare, one behind a Delta Media Group proof-of-work check - so their visual reviews are partly inferred from search-index text.

Desktop hero rendering of setrocgroup.com and the pricing/section layouts of several sites may be affected by assets (YouTube embeds, lazy counters) that do not paint in an automated session; those observations are flagged as such rather than stated as fact.
